query: EXPLAIN MATCH (c:V01 {uid:'V01:CG01'})-[r:HAS_ANALYSIS_MEMBER]->(b:V01) OPTIONAL MATCH (u:V01)-[:BOT_HAS_BUILDING]->(b) RETURN c.uid AS collection,labels(c) AS collectionLabels,b.uid AS building,r.ordinal AS ordinal,r.role AS role,collect(u.uid) AS dwellingOwners,b.footprintXY AS footprint,b.groundZM AS groundZM,b.eaveZM AS eaveZM,b.ridgeZM AS ridgeZM ORDER BY ordinal
